paragraphs.text: The latest addition is [[no-215-huawei-buzaoche-hongmeng-zhixing-daodi-shi-shenme-1007636843]], a [[Banlatte]] episode on [[Huawei]]'s automotive ecosystem and the meaning of [[HongmengZhixing|鸿蒙智行]]. It adds [[HongmengZhixing]], [[AITO]], [[Luxeed]], [[Stelato]], [[Shangjie]], [[Maextro]], [[ShenzhenYinwang]], [[BAICGroup]], [[SAICMotor]], [[JACGroup]], [[Avatr]], [[HuaweiSmartSelectionCarModel]], [[HuaweiNoCarManufacturingBoundary]], and [[AutomotiveChannelMigration]], while extending [[Seres]], [[Chery]], [[YuChengdong]], [[RenZhengfei]], [[HuaweiOrganizationalMethodology]], [[HighEndEVBranding]], [[SmartDrivingDemocratization]], [[RangeExtendedEV]], [[EVProductLineClarity]], [[AutonomousDrivingDataFlywheel]], and [[AutonomousDrivingResponsibilityBoundary]]. Its core synthesis is that Huawei's "not making cars" boundary is formal but not shallow: partner automakers keep qualification, factories, manufacturing, and vehicle revenue, while Huawei supplies product definition, intelligent systems, retail channels, service standards, brand launches, and the broader Yinwang supplier platform. No direct contradiction is recorded; delivery, ranking, revenue, and installation figures remain source-scoped to the episode's cited claims.

The latest addition is [[who-decides-what-big-box-sells-our-game-got-us-answers]], a [[PlanetMoney]] episode continuing the [[SellMeASasquatch]] branch from naming into big-box retail approval, production, and launch. It adds [[MattAdelman]], [[ToriWelch]], [[RetailLineReview]], [[PlanogramGatekeeping]], [[RetailPricePointProductScoping]], [[AudienceBackedRetailPitch]], [[MassRetailProductionDeadline]], and [[LicensedProductRiskAllocation]], while extending [[ExplodingKittens]], [[MarketForLemons]], [[AsymmetricInformation]], [[RetailShelfAppeal]], [[RetailShelfPlacement]], [[PackagingAsProductExperience]], [[ProductLaunchUnderConstraint]], [[Target]], [[Walmart]], [[ErikaBeras]], and [[KennyMalone]]. Its core synthesis is that turning an economics mechanic into a mass-retail product requires a second gate after good gameplay: buyers need audience, price, shelf, and planogram confidence, while the product team must translate that acceptance into royalties, material scope, factory deadlines, packaging quality, and launch support. No direct contradiction is recorded; the pitch-room retailer remains source-scoped because the episode withholds its identity.

The latest addition is [[145-gaijia-zhongzi-de-canyin-yangpinpai-feng-tou-quan-1-145-1]], a [[FengTouQuan]] episode on foreign restaurant brands shifting China control toward local capital and operators. It adds [[SubwayChina]], [[CITICCapital]], [[CarlyleGroup]], [[MeetFresh]], [[CFBGroup]], [[FangyuanCapital]], [[Ningji]], [[YumBrands]], [[ForeignRestaurantBrandLocalControl]], [[DemandSupplyChainControlFrame]], and [[FragranceSupplyChainMoat]], while extending [[McDonalds]], [[BurgerKing]], [[Starbucks]], [[BoyuCapital]], [[CPEYuanfeng]], [[YumChina]], [[PizzaHutChina]], [[HaagenDazs]], [[GeneralMills]], [[YerenXiansheng]], [[DairyQueen]], [[GlobalProductLocalization]], [[LocalPartnerMarketEntry]], [[FranchiseLedConsumerChainExpansion]], [[FreshMadeIceCreamRetail]], [[RestaurantExperienceDesign]], [[ExperientialRetail]], [[ConsumerBrandMoat]], [[SupplyChainSovereignty]], [[ChineseFragrance]], [[FragranceProductStorytelling]], and [[EmotionEconomy]]. Its core synthesis is that restaurant localization can require control-rights transfer, not only menu tweaks: food demand is highly local and operationally fast-moving, but the source's broader frame warns that local consumer heat must still be tested against upstream supply-chain control, as shown by the fragrance industry. No direct contradiction is recorded; Pizza Hut timing is kept as announcement-versus-completion variation, and the Hong Kong savings-insurance segment remains source-scoped commercial content.

The latest addition is [[ep276-duihua-jiazhangke-shang-yige-shidai-zouyuan-yiding-shi-yinwei-lingyige-shidai-zai-kaojin-ni-lqzsj-ujv-gpem-796cvncekdewc]], a [[TalkSanlian|Talk三联]] episode with [[JiaZhangke|贾樟柯]] on short-video rediscovery, ordinary-life poetics, youth mobility, and era transition. It adds [[ZhaoTao|赵涛]], [[ShanHeGuRen|《山河故人》]], [[JiangHuErNv|《江湖儿女》]], [[TianZhuDing|《天注定》]], [[FengLiuYiDai|《风流一代》]], [[CuiJian|崔健]], [[FilmClipRemixAfterlife]], [[OrdinaryLifePoetics]], [[MobilityFarewellGeneration]], [[VirtualPhysicalLifeBalance]], and [[EraTransitionProximity]], while extending [[AttentionFragmentation]], [[AttentionIndustrialization]], [[PlatformAffordance]], [[AlgorithmicPublicAppearance]], [[GenerationalTechnologyBridge]], [[YouthHappinessAfterGrowth]], and the EP277 branch around [[AIVideoProductionWorkflow]], [[LiveActionFilmUnderAI]], and [[FilmRealityBeyondRealism]]. Its core synthesis is that older film scenes become newly legible when platform remix meets lived continuity: labor, hometown, dance, farewell, and drifting youth carry feelings that are not locked to one generation, while AI and new community forms make the receding old era visible because another era is already approaching. No settled contradiction is recorded; EP276 keeps AI as an era-change and anxiety marker where EP277 develops the film-production argument.

The latest addition is [[ep277-duihua-jiazhangke-xia-wo-meiyou-beipan-zhenshi-shijie-wo-zhishi-zai-xunzhao-dianying-de-xin-keneng-lqprbtgi7pkch3hj3wxa1q8wovox]], a [[TalkSanlian|Talk三联]] episode with [[JiaZhangke|贾樟柯]] on AI cinema, realism, and film production. It adds [[JiaZhangke|贾樟柯]], [[PingyaoInternationalFilmFestival|平遥国际电影展]], and [[FilmRealityBeyondRealism]], while extending [[AIVideoProductionWorkflow]], [[LiveActionFilmUnderAI]], [[CreativeLaborAIBacklash]], [[AIPublicLikenessGeneration]], [[AITrainingCopyrightDispute]], [[AIEnergyBottleneck]], [[CharlieChaplin|卓别林]], and [[MartinScorsese|Martin Scorsese]]. Its core synthesis is that "responding to the real world" is not the same as using only realist photographic methods: Jia sees AI as a possible production-method rupture that may eventually form its own aesthetics, while still treating live-action location work as his own main creative home and keeping rights, labor, and energy constraints unresolved. No settled contradiction is recorded.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1001-weishenme-quan-ni-buyao-fanzhongnu-lolurkcjpie14nnczk0tu7iqerke]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode supplying the missing pre-claim setup for [[YuanShu|袁术]] before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1002-yuanshu-chengdi-hou-sunce-chengwei-zui-da-ying-llya3c2-pefujwxdxefvqxwxjizjo|Hanji 1002]] and [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1015-sanguo-luanshi-weishenme-yuanshu-gan-chengdi-lim0jemkwyjcesj2nvsr3jndhxfk|Hanji 1015]]. It adds [[YanXiangLateHan|阎象]], [[ZhangFanLateHan|张范]], [[ZhangChengLateHan|张承]], and [[HeirloomImperialSeal|传国玉玺]], while extending [[MingqiLegitimacy|名器合法性]], [[TitleRealityRestraint|名实相符式名号节制]], [[AntiUsurpationCoalitionPressure|讨逆同盟压力]], [[ChenweiPolitics|谶纬政治]], [[YinYangFivePhasesPoliticalTheory|阴阳五行政治理论]], [[MandateOfHeavenLegitimacy|天命合法性]], and [[PeopleBasedPoliticalSecurity|民心型政治安全]]. Its core synthesis is that Yuan Shu's claim fails before the coronation: prophecy, five-phases logic, the seal, territory, population, and troops cannot substitute for virtue, name-rightness, adviser support, or people-support. No settled contradiction is recorded; the source's omen and seal claims are kept as Yuan Shu's self-authorization logic rather than accepted mandate evidence.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1002-yuanshu-chengdi-hou-sunce-chengwei-zui-da-ying-llya3c2-pefujwxdxefvqxwxjizjo]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode that supplies the immediate prelude to [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1003-sanguo-zui-bei-digu-de-moushi-dongzhao-llc7q-loennxw26v3u5cbhitikw1|Hanji 1003]] and the later [[YuanShu|袁术]] self-coronation branch. [[SunCe|孙策]] warns Yuan Shu that the current [[EmperorXianOfHan|汉献帝]] is not a Jie-or-Zhou-style tyrant and then breaks with Yuan Shu when the warning fails, while [[XunYu|荀彧]] tells [[CaoCao|曹操]] that welcoming the emperor can secure public feeling, strategic command, and talent before another actor seizes the same opportunity. The source adds [[LegitimacyWindowSeizure|合法性窗口抢占]] while extending [[AntiUsurpationCoalitionPressure|讨逆同盟压力]], [[MoralizedWarPretext|道德化战争借口]], [[MingqiLegitimacy|名器合法性]], and [[XingshiqingStrategicAssessment|行势情战略评估]]; no settled contradiction is recorded, and the title's "最大赢" wording is preserved as source-given.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1003-sanguo-zui-bei-digu-de-moushi-dongzhao-llc7q-loennxw26v3u5cbhitikw1]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode that supplies the immediate prelude to [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1004-caocao-yingfeng-hanxiandi-shi-shui-de-zhuyi-lrrga-flmx5ajnhu1c42x7kooe94|Hanji 1004]]. [[DongZhaoLateHan|董昭]] first helps [[CaoCao|曹操]] through [[ZhangYangLateHan|张杨]]'s Henei route, then writes to [[YangFengLateHan|杨奉]] in Cao Cao's name so the strongest route-blocking White Wave actor sees cooperation as praise, grain access, and mutual support rather than submission. [[DongChengLateHan|董承]]'s later request against [[HanXianLateHan|韩暹]] gives Cao Cao an overt reason to enter [[LuoyangLateHan|洛阳]], turning adviser initiative into court access. The source extends [[ProactiveAdviserInitiative|主动补位式谋臣]], [[InterestReframingPersuasion|利益重构式说服]], [[StrategicRecognitionAlignment|谋略知己式归附]], and [[XingshiqingStrategicAssessment|行势情战略评估]] while keeping Dong Zhao's underrecognized-genius framing and Zhang Yang's mixed role source-scoped.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1004-caocao-yingfeng-hanxiandi-shi-shui-de-zhuyi-lrrga-flmx5ajnhu1c42x7kooe94]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode that supplies the immediate prelude to [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1005-sunce-zhuding-zaoshi-shi-xingge-jueding-mingyun-lpqnere2cwcrngggyezd-bsqahx4|Hanji 1005]] through [[CaoCao|曹操]]'s move from [[LuoyangLateHan|洛阳]] to [[Xudu|许都]] and [[SunCe|孙策]]'s first [[KuaijiCommandery|会稽郡]] campaign. [[DongZhaoLateHan|董昭]] reads Luoyang's ruined supply base and competing military actors as a control failure, then advises Cao Cao to reassure [[YangFengLateHan|杨奉]] and move [[EmperorXianOfHan|汉献帝]] to Xu; [[SunJingLateHan|孙静]] reads [[WangLangLateHan|王朗]]'s Guling defense as a reason for rear attack and deception. The source extends [[StrategicCapitalRelocation|战略性迁都]], [[XingshiqingStrategicAssessment|行势情战略评估]], [[PoliticalSurvivalFirst|安全第一政治生存]], [[MingqiLegitimacy|名器合法性]], and [[LeaderPersonalExposure|领导者轻身涉险]] while keeping Sun Ce's later-death foreshadowing source-scoped.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1005-sunce-zhuding-zaoshi-shi-xingge-jueding-mingyun-lpqnere2cwcrngggyezd-bsqahx4]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode that supplies the immediate prelude to [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1006-guojia-buman-yuanshao-weihe-que-neng-guishun-caocao-lup-p-inz1sdlhpnaggqjp0eavar|Hanji 1006]] through [[SunCe|孙策]]'s [[KuaijiCommandery|会稽郡]] risk case and [[CaoCao|曹操]]'s early [[Xudu|许都]] title-management branch. [[YuFan|虞翻]] warns Sun Ce that solo hunting in light clothing turns ordinary freedom into [[LeaderPersonalExposure|领导者轻身涉险]], while Cao Cao attacks [[YangFengLateHan|杨奉]], uses [[EmperorXianOfHan|汉献帝]]'s court to manage [[YuanShao|袁绍]], and yields the great-general rank as [[StrategicTitleConcession|战略性名位让步]]. The same source previews the [[XunYu|荀彧]] recommendation channel for [[XunYou|荀攸]] and [[GuoJia|郭嘉]], extending [[PoliticalSurvivalFirst|安全第一政治生存]], [[XingshiqingStrategicAssessment|行势情战略评估]], and [[MingqiLegitimacy|名器合法性]] while keeping transcript variants "徐玉", "徐悠", and "过家" source-scoped.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1006-guojia-buman-yuanshao-weihe-que-neng-guishun-caocao-lup-p-inz1sdlhpnaggqjp0eavar]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode that supplies the immediate prelude to [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1007-cong-shentong-dao-fuwang-kongrong-zhenshi-mianmu-puguang-lkiljj4yvl5fhslrc9gcxudxxklt|Hanji 1007]]. [[GuoJia|郭嘉]] rejects [[YuanShao|袁绍]] because polite treatment and Yuan-family prestige do not compensate for poor priority judgment and weak personnel use, then recognizes [[CaoCao|曹操]] as the ruler who can turn strategic advice into action. The episode pairs Guo Jia's bold forecasts with [[XunYou|荀攸]]'s cautious secrecy, then uses [[ManChong|满宠]] executing [[CaoHong|曹洪]]'s lawbreaking clients to create [[RuleOverKinshipPower|法度压过亲缘特权]]: Cao Cao's order can recruit capable non-clan advisers only if officials also believe family access will not erase standards. This extends [[TalentAsStateTreasure|以贤臣为宝]], [[TalentAttractionThroughRespect|礼贤下士式人才吸附]], [[XingshiqingStrategicAssessment|行势情战略评估]], [[PoliticalSurvivalFirst|安全第一政治生存]], and [[MeritBasedRewardPunishment|因功赏罚]] without settling any new contradiction.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1007-cong-shentong-dao-fuwang-kongrong-zhenshi-mianmu-puguang-lkiljj4yvl5fhslrc9gcxudxxklt]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode that supplies the immediate prelude to [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1008-ruhe-pingjia-caocao-de-tuntianzhi-ls8wvh9ox-pcjmt0z8w82opbha-k|Hanji 1008]]. It opens with [[WhiteBearEffect|白熊效应]] and the host's "转移、替代、升华" response, then turns [[KongRong|孔融]]'s [[BeihaiCommandery|北海郡]] governorship into [[PrestigeCapacityGap|名望能力落差]]: lineage from [[Confucius|孔子]], childhood fame, literary status, and respect for [[ZhengXuan|郑玄]] do not become troops, grain, strategic alignment, or safe advice channels. [[ZuoChengzu|左承祖]] reads the field realistically by urging dependence on a stronger power such as [[YuanShao|袁绍]], [[CaoCao|曹操]], or [[GongsunZan|公孙瓒]], but Kong Rong kills him, [[LiuYixun|刘义逊]] leaves, and [[YuanTan|袁谭]] later takes Beihai. This extends [[XingshiqingStrategicAssessment|行势情战略评估]], [[TalentAsStateTreasure|以贤臣为宝]], [[PoliticalSurvivalFirst|安全第一政治生存]], and [[CourtFeedbackCollapse|君臣反馈失灵]] without settling any new contradiction.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1009-liubei-touben-caocao-xianxie-langru-hukou-llm0ds4krkptjdtb71hbusnpzbdc]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode filling the missing late-Han prelude before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1010-sanguo-liubiao-jiujing-shibushi-piaoliang-de-caobao-lo58hzfo-qv0soauogtgfrkourrd|Hanji 1010]]. It adds [[YuanHuanLateHan|袁涣]], [[ThreatDrivenAllianceReversal|威胁感驱动的同盟反转]], [[ReputationConstrainedTalentProtection|名声约束下的人才保护]], and [[MoralDisengagementRationalization|道德推脱式自我合理化]], while extending [[LiuBei|刘备]], [[LyuBu|吕布]], [[CaoCao|曹操]], [[GuoJia|郭嘉]], [[PeiCounty|小沛]], [[TalentAttractionThroughRespect|礼贤下士式人才吸附]], and [[DunningKrugerEffect|Dunning-Kruger effect]]. Its core synthesis is that the Liu Bei-Lü Bu-Cao Cao triangle turns alliance into reputation strategy: Lü Bu's fear of Liu Bei's growth pushes a possible ally into Cao Cao's camp, Guo Jia frames sparing Liu Bei as necessary for Cao Cao's wider talent market, and Yuan Huan's refusal to abuse Liu Bei blocks Lü Bu's attempt to launder betrayal through public slander. No settled contradiction is recorded; the source's masculinity and Dunning-Kruger readings are kept as source-scoped interpretation rather than independent evidence of inner motive.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1010-sanguo-liubiao-jiujing-shibushi-piaoliang-de-caobao-lo58hzfo-qv0soauogtgfrkourrd]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode filling the Liu Biao setup immediately before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1011-miheng-zhisi-zuiju-beiju-secai-de-jiedao-sharen-ltrzpchwdfcyp4ntmum9giu-5mva|Hanji 1011]]. It adds [[Jingzhou|荆州]], [[DuanWeiLateHan|段煨]], [[Rangcheng|穰城]], [[MourningFramedMilitaryAbsorption|丧礼化收编]], and [[DefensiveLocalGovernance|保境安民式守成治理]], while extending [[LiuBiao|刘表]], [[ZhangJiLateHan|张济]], [[ZhangXiu|张绣]], [[JiaXu|贾诩]], [[KuaiYue|蒯越]], [[CaiMao|蔡瑁]], [[NanyangCommandery|南阳郡]], [[WanCounty|宛县]], [[PoliticalSurvivalFirst|安全第一政治生存]], [[XingshiqingStrategicAssessment|行势情战略评估]], and [[LiAsPoliticalOrder|礼制政治秩序]]. Its core synthesis is that Liu Biao should not be reduced to a "pretty fool": he can use mourning, reassurance, elite alliances, refugee-friendly governance, and ritual restraint to preserve Jingzhou, but Jia Xu's evaluation keeps that strength bounded because Liu Biao lacks the change-reading and decisiveness needed for larger disorder-era expansion. No settled contradiction is recorded; the source's transcript variants are normalized to canonical late-Han names and the apparent "刘建" death detail is treated as a likely arrow/stray-arrow rendering rather than a person page.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1011-miheng-zhisi-zuiju-beiju-secai-de-jiedao-sharen-ltrzpchwdfcyp4ntmum9giu-5mva]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode filling the missing pre-Hanji-1012 late-Han branch through [[MiHengLateHan|祢衡]], [[KongRong|孔融]], [[CaoCao|曹操]], [[LiuBiao|刘表]], and [[HuangZu|黄祖]]. It adds [[MiHengLateHan|祢衡]], [[HuangZu|黄祖]], [[KuaiYue|蒯越]], [[CaiMao|蔡瑁]], and [[BorrowedKnifeKilling|借刀杀人]], while extending [[JiaXu|贾诩]], [[Analects|《论语》]], [[Confucius|孔子]], [[CovertPoliticalTechnology|阴谋式政治技术]], and [[PoliticalSurvivalFirst|安全第一政治生存]]. Its core synthesis is that Mi Heng's talent and public defiance become politically fatal once stronger actors can route risk through reputation management and delegated violence: Cao Cao avoids direct killing after public humiliation, Liu Biao redirects the disruptive guest into Huang Zu's hands, and Huang Zu supplies the immediate anger that completes the removal. No settled contradiction is recorded; the page disambiguates [[MiHengLateHan|祢衡]] from [[MiHeng|芈横 / 楚顷襄王]] and normalizes transcript variants for 黄祖, 蒯越, and 蔡瑁.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1012-haose-caocao-luanshi-zhong-de-dute-qingshi-llvrucihuv2buvp1-lisz4usbprh]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode that supplies the pre-disaster setup for the Wancheng branch before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1013-dianwei-zhisi-jingshi-caocao-haose-haileta-lhe6jrpjp3cfbdhvjtdiezijfnoh|Hanji 1013]]. It adds [[ZhangJiLateHan|张济]] and normalizes the Wancheng woman as [[LadyZouWancheng|邹氏]] while preserving Hanji 1013's "周氏" as a transcript variant; it also extends [[CaoCao|曹操]], [[ZhangXiu|张绣]], [[JiaXu|贾诩]], [[LiuBiao|刘表]], [[WanCounty|宛城]], [[DesireDrivenCommandExposure|私欲驱动的统帅暴露]], and [[StatusInsultDefectionCascade|名分羞辱触发叛变]]. Its core synthesis is that the surrender relationship is already fragile before open rebellion: Zhang Xiu inherits Zhang Ji's troops, follows Jia Xu's advice to submit, and has just entered Cao Cao's camp order when Cao Cao's taking of Zhang Ji's widow turns private desire into an affront to family status and new-subordinate trust. No settled contradiction is recorded; the episode stops before the night attack and leaves the tactical disaster to the next installment.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1013-dianwei-zhisi-jingshi-caocao-haose-haileta-lhe6jrpjp3cfbdhvjtdiezijfnoh]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode that supplies the Wancheng disaster immediately after [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1012-haose-caocao-luanshi-zhong-de-dute-qingshi-llvrucihuv2buvp1-lisz4usbprh|Hanji 1012]] and before [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1014-caocao-de-15-ge-laopo-dou-you-shui-lv-hyvprg73k8w8jspxjosqwmc69|Hanji 1014]]. [[CaoCao|曹操]] first appears through [[LadyDuCaoCao|杜夫人]] and [[LadyYinCaoCao|尹夫人]] as a household-desire actor, then the episode narrows to [[WanCounty|宛城]]: taking [[LadyZouWancheng|邹氏]], rewarding [[HuCheEr|胡车儿]], and leaking a plan against [[ZhangXiu|张绣]] let [[JiaXu|贾诩]] turn surrender resentment into a pre-emptive night attack. [[HuCheEr|胡车儿]] disables [[DianWei|典韦]] through drink and weapon theft, so [[AlcoholAsPowerCatalyst|酒作为权力催化剂]] now has a detailed guard-failure case inside [[DesireDrivenCommandExposure|私欲驱动的统帅暴露]]. The deaths of Dian Wei, [[CaoAng|曹昂]], and [[CaoAnmin|曹安民]] then feed directly into [[LadyDingCaoCao|丁夫人]]'s household rupture and the Hanji 1014 aftermath, while [[HeYan|何晏]] opens a smaller [[WeiJinStyleCulturalAfterlife|魏晋风度文化后效]] bridge. The source adds no settled contradiction; its strongest causal slogan is kept as source-scoped shorthand rather than the whole explanation.

The latest addition is [[zizhi-tongjian-hanji-1014-caocao-de-15-ge-laopo-dou-you-shui-lv-hyvprg73k8w8jspxjosqwmc69]], a [[RuiqiJiangtouZizhiTongjian|芮淇讲透资治通鉴]] episode bridging the Wancheng aftermath and the Hanji 1015 late-Han sequencing branch through [[CaoCao|曹操]], [[YuJin|于禁]], [[XunYu|荀彧]], [[GuoJia|郭嘉]], and [[YuanShao|袁绍]]. It adds [[LadyDingCaoCao|丁夫人]], [[LadyBianCaoCao|卞夫人]], [[FenxiangMailu|分香卖履]], [[CrisisFirstMilitaryDiscipline|临危先务军纪]], and [[TenVictoriesTenDefeats|十胜十败论]], while extending [[CaoAng|曹昂]], [[XingshiqingStrategicAssessment|行势情战略评估]], [[MeritBasedRewardPunishment|因功赏罚]], and [[TalentAsStateTreasure|以贤臣为宝]].
